script_text: Aquarius, Uranus fires your 10th House of career July 30, and your Air-sign ambition is about to shift. Saturn sextile Venus in your 7th House makes Monday and Tuesday ideal for love and partnership. But Wednesday's Mars square Neptune in your 12th House clouds judgment — avoid trusting everyone. Monday beats Wednesday clearly. Thursday brings the Sun conjunct Jupiter in Taurus activating your 2nd House for a real financial breakthrough. Venus enters your 8th House Friday, forcing honest talk about shared money with partners. The weekend's Cancer Full Moon floods your 5th House with new romance and creative fire Saturday through Sunday. Thursday is your power day because Sun conjunct Jupiter floods your 2nd House with abundance. Wednesday is your worst day because Mars square Neptune in your 12th House invites deception. Trust the career shift Uranus triggers Monday and seize Jupiter's money opening Thursday. Follow for daily Aquarius updates.
